newsitem.title: UK: Use of gilt repos will modernise operations - BOE.
newsitem.headline: Use of gilt repos will modernise operations - BOE.

text.p: Executive director of the Bank of England Ian Plenderleith said changes such as the use of gilt repos would help to simplify and modernise the Bank's money market operations.
"It also moves us onto a basis of more open access for major money market counterparties to our daily operations," he told a news conference.
"That process should help to enhance the efficiency and competitiveness of the sterling money market in London."
It also reflected the coming-of-age of gilt repo as a major international money market instrument.

"It represents a tendency towards the international model of modern central bank money market operations," Plenderleith said. That process of convergence on a common model was not just confined to Europe but was being adopted or considered in countries such as the United States, Canada and Japan.
